theorem lg_target {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {f : Set (α → β)} {s : Set α} (hf : f.Finite) (hs : s.Finite) : (f.seq s).Finite := by
  let f_seq : Set (s → β) := f.seq s
  let g : s → β := fun x => ⟨x⟩
  have h_image : (Set.image g s).Finite :=
    Set.Finite.image hf hs
  exact h_image
